messages:
nidhi: Heads-up: Harbortide private deployment dry-run tomorrow 07:30 PT. We need the final KMS ARN, exact cross-account role name and trust policy, S3 bucket for audit logs and whether object lock is enabled, plus outbound CIDRs. Please post by EOD. Tagging @harbortide-sre

harbortide-sre: KMS ARN = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:9988776655:key/htd-main-2026. Cross-account role = RedwoodAccess_Harbortide. Audit bucket = s3://harbortide-redwood-audit. Object lock currently ENABLED (legacy). We'll coordinate to disable before cutover if Redwood confirms lifecycle needs. Outbound CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/16 -> 34.201.100.0/24:443, 10.40.3.0/24 -> 18.210.22.0/24:443

carlos: network finding from staging: internal resolver returned old VIP for redwood-api.private.harbortide. Please add internal A record `redwood-api.private.harbortide` -> 10.40.3.17 with TTL=45 and confirm split-horizon is in place.

meera: audit retention note: Harbortide requested 30d retention. We recommended minimum 90d; customer insists 30d due to storage policy. Marked as non-blocker but note for renewal conversation. :ledger:

nidhi: can you paste the IAM trust policy we should see on RedwoodAccess_Harbortide? Need to validate sts:AssumeRole principal + ExternalId. Example below (please paste exact policy you applied):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/redwood-deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "harbortide-ext-21"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

harbortide-sre: pasted trust policy but ExternalId currently set to harbortide-ext-99 per their security admin. We'll update to harbortide-ext-21 and confirm ARN when done. Also note: object lock disable requires approval from compliance; they said yes earlier, getting final sign-off now.

deploy-bot: reminder: dry-run job dj-11723 scheduled for 2026-03-26T15:30:00Z. Will post run start/completion in channel.

harbortide-sre: small heads-up: KMS rotation is scheduled in 4 days; we'll postpone rotation until after cutover by creating alias `alias/rdw-fallback` pointing to current key for emergency decrypt if needed.

carlos: ops please add smoke command to runbook and paste output here after dry-run:
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://redwood-api.private.harbortide/healthz | jq .`

meera: renewal flag: Harbortide in month 10 of trial. If dry-run completes with <=1 incident we'll hand to sales for renewal outreach. If >1 incident, escalate internally and add to risk register. Tagging @sales for visibility. :triangular_flag_on_post:

harbortide-sre: post-dry-run summary: dry-run started 2026-03-26T15:30:10Z. Smoke results: healthz OK, embeddings endpoint had two transient 429s under synthetic burst then recovered. KV warmup hit one miss in generate path but fallback succeeded. Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-26T15:31:02Z] WARN 429 /v1/embeddings - burst retry 1
[2026-03-26T15:31:03Z] INFO 200 /v1/embeddings - retry ok
[2026-03-26T15:31:11Z] ERROR 503 /v1/generate - kvcache miss fallback
[2026-03-26T15:31:12Z] INFO 200 /v1/generate - retry ok
```
Ticket HT-88 opened to adjust cache warmup and burst retry policy.

nidhi: thanks. Renewal risk flagged HT-88. If the embedding 429s persist during the production cut, that will impact renewal negotiation. Ops please add mitigation steps to runbook: increase pre-warm, backoff retries.

harbortide-sre: confirmed object lock will be disabled by 2026-03-27 10:00 PT and trust policy ExternalId updated to harbortide-ext-21. Will paste final role ARN after change.

carlos: once you paste final IAM role ARN and confirm S3 object lock off we can approve cutover slot. Leaving thread open for final confirmations. :white_check_mark:
